schema: MIRF stored Bootstrap site audit v1
method: Read-only checks of the stored formal manifests, indices checksums and recorded diagnostics against the scalar members of the site archives and the historical acceptance predicate. No arrays h/J opened, no refit, no gradient or parameter variability recomputed.
site_rows_index: Zero-based site id is the row index within each replicate; status_ranges give the status and flags for each inclusive range.
